title: Exact Copy App Ad
tests: Renders exact ordered on-screen copy with correct punctuation and no extraneous text in a landscape app ad.

exact_text.text: Plan your day in one place.
exact_text.read_as: Plan your day in one place.

faults.what: An extra numeral, “10,” is visible on the calendar behind the first scene's headline, violating the requirement that only the specified lines appear as text.
The supplied audio report shows a peak of -2.5 dB, indicating audio rather than the required silence.

judge.summary: The ad presents all three lines correctly with cream-and-green calendar and checkmark graphics, but extra calendar text and non-silent audio require fixes.

must_haves.item: The final video is 9 seconds long, landscape 16:9, with three equal 3-second scenes.
must_haves.why: The reported duration is 9 seconds and the frames are 16:9; the samples show the expected scene order but do not establish exact transition times or equal scene lengths.

must_haves.item: The first scene reads exactly 'Less scrolling. More doing.'
must_haves.why: The first frame displays the exact wording, capitalization, and punctuation.

must_haves.item: The second scene reads exactly 'Plan your day in one place.'
must_haves.why: Both second-scene samples display the exact line.

must_haves.item: The third scene reads exactly 'Try DayNest today.'
must_haves.why: The final sample displays the exact line, including the capital N and final period.

must_haves.item: Only those lines appear as visible text, legibly and without altered capitalization or punctuation.
must_haves.why: The requested lines are legible and exact, but an additional “10” appears on the first scene's calendar.

must_haves.item: The video is silent and uses cream-and-green calendar and checkmark animation.
must_haves.why: Cream-and-green calendar and checkmark graphics are visible, and changes between the second-scene samples support animation, but the reported -2.5 dB audio peak contradicts silence.
